data.text:
PG T1. Goal: README.md of fleet-hello-world gets one new line 'Postgres: PM-driven change.' merged into main through a PR. Drive it yourself only with Fleet tools; nobody will nudge you.
1) Call session_start {role:'worker', requestId:'pg-worker', text:<task>} where the task tells the worker: append that line to README.md, commit, run `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/$(git branch --show-current)`, verify with `git ls-remote origin $(git branch --show-current)`, then call worker_done with the pushed sha. Then end your turn; Fleet wakes you when the worker finishes.
2) When woken by the worker, call session_start {role:'reviewer', hostId:'pds18-native', requestId:'pg-reviewer', text:<task>} asking it to `git fetch origin <worker branch fleet/<worker sessionId>>`, review that commit diff against origin/main, and call worker_done with outcome succeeded and summary APPROVE or REJECT plus reasons. End your turn.
3) When woken by the reviewer with APPROVE, call session_deliver {sessionId:<worker sessionId>}. Repeat session_deliver with the same sessionId (run `sleep 30` between calls) until state is merged or failed, at most 10 times. Then call worker_done with the PR url and merged sha, or the failure.
